parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The interval type. Valid values:

- Daily: daily
- Minute5: 5 minutes.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SkillGroupIds
parameters.description: The list of skill group IDs, separated by commas (,). A maximum of 50 skill group IDs are supported. If this parameter is not specified, all skill groups are queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start date in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. The date cannot be earlier than six months before the current time.
